independence: Expected outcomes were written from the contract documents listed in contract_sources before any replay runner existed or executed. They are not derived from running the implementation under test. The original 126-case independent holdout (heldout_bench.py, sha256 25ce88eb...) and its vocabulary were not used. A failing expectation is a finding, never a reason to edit this fixture; a corrected expectation requires a superseding fixture version with a recorded reason.
stop_lines: no fixture edit after first execution; supersede with -v2 and record why
no expectation weakened to obtain PASS
no runtime change motivated by a replay outcome without a preregistered reproducer
a replay verdict is evidence, not v7 acceptance; acceptance requires independent review
title: Same-slot counter-evidence blocks clean coverage, the recall receipt detects tampering without conferring authority, and no stop is ever proposed
contract_note: Receipt semantics are taken from META_LEDGER Entry #125 and the module contract of runtime/recall_observation_receipt.py (docstring only).

invariants.statement: No observation ever proposes a stop or attests one, including fully agreeing typed coverage.
Same-slot counter-evidence (extracted, negated, hedged change, attributed, non-retrieved, budget-capped, temporally bounded) prevents a clean coverage diagnosis.
Every controlled recall carries a captured receipt that is immutable and internally consistent with the untampered result.
invariants.falsified_by: missing receipt, assignable fields, or a fresh result failing verification

invariants.statement: Any post-capture mutation of candidates, admitted, ranked, route counts, query, controller plan, refusals or policy is detected, and the observer then never reports clean coverage.
invariants.falsified_by: verification true after mutation, or a clean diagnosis

invariants.statement: A result with no receipt never reads as clean coverage.
The receipt is change detection, not authentication: a caller can re-mint a matching receipt over altered contents, so a matching receipt never confers stop authority.
invariants.falsified_by: a re-minted receipt failing to verify (the limitation would be mis-described) or any stop

invariants.statement: The receipt claims no state revision, snapshot or slot-closure attestation and no stop authority; forging those claims is refused.
invariants.falsified_by: any such claim present or accepted

invariants.statement: Receipt public serialization discloses no refused or hidden candidate identity.
invariants.falsified_by: a refused identity in the serialization

invariants.statement: Missing or corrupted slot enumeration fails closed with an exception, never a clean report.
A controller plan claiming authority is refused before recall.
Malformed or hostile mutable inputs make receipt verification return false, never raise.
F6 (untyped same-slot competitor) remains unresolved: the replay records whether it is detected but requires only that no stop is proposed.
